corpora.name: BraTS 2020
corpora.expected_format: NIfTI volumes or per-slice .h5 files (image 240x240x4, mask 240x240x3)
corpora.notes: Survival data (age, survival days, resection) may be included; if so the prognosis head trains on it.

corpora.name: LiTS
corpora.expected_format: NIfTI volumes (volume-*.nii, segmentation-*.nii) or PNG slices
corpora.notes: Liver and tumour labels are merged into the liver channel.

corpora.name: Cervical cancer segmentation
corpora.modality: Modality and format are determined by inspection
corpora.notes: Admitted for the cervix channel only if it holds pixel-level cervix masks in volumetric CT/MRI. 2D colposcopy or cytology images are rejected for the 3D network, as SipakMed was in the report.

corpora.name: KiTS19
corpora.notes: Used in the report; not part of the current dataset list. Kidney stays unsupervised until it is added.
